output: html_document
---

```{r}
library("httr")
library("jsonlite")

url <- "https://api.data.gov/ed/collegescorecard/v1/schools"

api_key <- Sys.getenv("COLLEGE_SCORECARD_KEY")
```

# Get the API from 
```{r}
scoreCard <- GET(
  url,
  query = list(
    api_key = api_key,
    school.state = "IA"
  )
)

str(scoreCard)
```

# Store the results
```{r}
# Convert to JSON string
scoreCardContent <- httr::content(scoreCard, as = "text")

str(scoreCardContent)

# Convert JSON to R object
scoreCardData <- jsonlite::fromJSON(scoreCardContent)

# Store results in a data frame
iowaSchools <- scoreCardData$results

View(iowaSchools)
```
